description: Every setting the admin UI can edit. Values are saved to .env (git-ignored). Read by admin-ui and scripts/run_local.py.

settings.label: Telnyx public key
settings.help: Mission Control -> Keys & Credentials -> Public Key (verifies webhook signatures on Edge)

settings.label: Session actor URL
settings.help: URL printed by: telnyx-edge ship --from-dir services/session-actor

settings.label: Internal API token
settings.help: Any random string; same value as the INTERNAL_API_TOKEN Edge secret

settings.label: MCP API key
settings.help: Any random string; Telnyx sends it to the MCP server as a bearer token

settings.label: Webhook URL (Edge)
settings.help: URL printed by: telnyx-edge ship --from-dir services/webhook

settings.label: MCP server URL (Edge)
settings.help: URL printed by: telnyx-edge ship --from-dir services/mcp-server

settings.label: Assistant model
settings.help: Telnyx-hosted model id for the voice assistant

settings.label: Assistant phone number (E.164)
settings.help: The number callers dial; used as caller id for transfers

settings.label: Transfer-to number (E.164)
settings.help: A person to transfer to; leave empty to disable transfers

settings.label: Phone number id
settings.help: Mission Control -> Numbers; provisioning routes it to the assistant

settings.label: Max call length (seconds)
settings.help: Calls longer than this go to goodbye (default 300)
